chunks: From him, from a man who saw as if the sun were rising upon his feet, apart from his body, he said:

Wealth that he acquires from the produce of the earth, from wheat or dates, which he treads with his feet and holds onto, and it is permissible, except that he will toil for it as Adam (peace be upon him) toiled.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean if one dreams of the sun shining on their feet?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Al-Kafi*, the Imam interprets the dream of the sun rising on one's feet as a sign of acquiring halal wealth through agriculture, specifically wheat and dates. The imagery highlights that while the wealth is permissible, it requires significant toil and effort to acquire, drawing a parallel to the labor of Adam (peace be upon him) in cultivating the earth. This interpretation underscores the Shia scholarly emphasis on the virtue of honest labor and the spiritual significance of everyday economic activities.

en.hubeali: H 14894 – From him, from a man who saw (in a dream) as if the sun emerging upon his feet apart from his body, who has narrated the following:

Imamasws said regarding a man who saw (in a dream) that sun shine on his feet and not on his body, ‘he will acquire plenty of wealth from the plantations of the earth, from wheat and dates which he will tread by his feet and hold on to it, and it is Permissible, except that he will have to toil for it as Adamas toiled’.
